provenance.source_title: How Did Humans Communicate Before Speech

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒抛出悖论预告：在X之前已有别的东西，且它奠定了今天的一切
examples.expression_mechanism: Before X, they had something else 式悖论预告 + 短断言
examples.example_text: Before humans had words, they had something else.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'在X之前已有Y'的悖论句式一句话制造信息缺口
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该句式中的具体对象与场景设定

examples.psychological_goal: 把抽象的核心问题压缩成一个观众能立刻代入的具象两难场景
examples.expression_mechanism: How did + 一个不可能的具身任务 的问句，把大问题变成画面
examples.example_text: How did early humans say, "Hey, there's a lion behind you." without actually saying it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'如何在不使用X的情况下完成X今天做的事'的具身两难场景落地核心问题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景内容；两难场景必须与主题强相关

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众刚做的具身体验重新定性为'古老硬件'，并用硬数字坐实
examples.expression_mechanism: This is + 技术隐喻定性 + 精确数字硬事实
examples.example_text: This is ancient hardware. The human face has 43 muscles.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用一句隐喻定性重新框定体验，再紧跟一个硬数字完成证据落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该隐喻与数字；定性必须能被后文证据支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用跨文化对照证明该能力不是习得而是生物本能
examples.expression_mechanism: 普遍性断言 + 两个相距极远的地点对照
examples.example_text: The basic expressions are universal. Fear looks the same in rural Papua New Guinea as it does in downtown Tokyo.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个地理与文化上反差极大的地点作对照，为'普遍性'提供画面化证据
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该地点组合；对照两端必须都真实成立

examples.psychological_goal: 用观众熟悉的宠物行为反差制造微笑，同时坐实人类行为的独特性
examples.expression_mechanism: 跨物种反差白描：你投入一辈子，它依然看错对象
examples.example_text: You can spend your whole life with a dog and it will look at your finger, not what you're pointing at.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习借一个人人有经验的动物反差瞬间，让论点在笑声中落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该动物与场景；笑点必须服务论证而非插科打诨

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句对仗隐喻把整章论证压缩成可复述的格言
examples.expression_mechanism: A built the road. B just learned to drive on it. 式前后对仗隐喻
examples.example_text: The hands built the road. The mouth just learned to drive on it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在章末用一对共享同一意象的对仗短句为整章盖章
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象；隐喻必须准确反映前后两者的真实关系

examples.psychological_goal: 在两个通道之间换挡：先否定两个错误答案，再给出正确通道
examples.expression_mechanism: X, not A, not B, just X 式排除法定焦
examples.example_text: Sound, not language, not words, just sound.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'是X，不是A，不是B，只是X'的排除结构为新章节精确划界
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；排除的选项必须是读者脑中真实存在的误预期

examples.psychological_goal: 用一组对仗数字把前面的案例清单压缩成一句实锤
examples.expression_mechanism: same X, same Y, three different A, three different B 式对称收数
examples.example_text: Same species, same troop, three different sounds, three different behavioral responses.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在清单之后用'同一…同一…三个不同…三个不同…'的对称句式完成定锤
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单内容；对称收数必须与前文清单一一对应

examples.psychological_goal: 在否定与肯定之间为概念精确定位，防止过度宣称也不贬低对象
examples.expression_mechanism: This is not X. But it's not nothing either. 式让步-置换判决
examples.example_text: This is not language. But it's not nothing either.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不是X，但也不是零'的双句结构为中间态概念校准位置
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用；前后两次否定必须对应真实的分类争议

examples.psychological_goal: 用行为证据三连反转对一个群体的'无能'成见
examples.expression_mechanism: They did A. They did B. There's evidence they did C. 式行为清单递增
examples.example_text: They buried their dead. They made pigments. There's evidence they wore eagle talons as personal ornaments.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用短句行为清单逐项加码，让'他们不可能没有X'的结论自己浮现
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该行为清单；每一项必须是真实可查的证据

examples.psychological_goal: 借署名学者的形象化理论命名，一举解决前文铺垫的规模难题
examples.expression_mechanism: 学者背书 + 'X at a distance'式形象化概念命名
examples.example_text: early music and rhythmic vocalization might have functioned as a kind of grooming at a distance.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在引出署名理论时保留其形象化命名，让抽象机制瞬间可懂
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该理论与命名；引用理论须忠于原意

examples.psychological_goal: 完成主从反转：当新旧信号冲突时，被信任的永远是旧的
examples.expression_mechanism: You don't believe the A. You believe the B. 式对照判决
examples.example_text: You don't believe the words. You believe the body.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你不信A，你信B'的同构对照句把主从反转钉进观众记忆
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对照对象；反转必须有前文实证支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句干冷的让步幽默为通道能力划界，防止过度宣称
examples.expression_mechanism: You can't X a question 式范畴错位让步句
examples.example_text: You can't smell a question or smell an argument.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'它做不到某件显然属于另一范畴的事'的让步句精准划定能力边界
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；让步必须落在真实的能力极限上

examples.psychological_goal: 给出全片最关键的代理推理：器物所需的认知架构恰好等于语言所需的架构
examples.expression_mechanism: 术语定性 + The same X that underlies Y 式等同论证
examples.example_text: This is hierarchical sequential cognition. The same cognitive architecture that underlies syntax
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给一个术语定性，再用'正是支撑Y的那套X'把两个领域接通
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该术语与论证；等同关系必须是学界真实支持的推断

examples.psychological_goal: 在主论证完成后开启最后一个维度，让观众愿意多停留一章
examples.expression_mechanism: There's one more thing worth discussing. + 单词点题
examples.example_text: There's one more thing worth discussing. The role of teaching.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'还有一件事值得谈'加单词点题的两拍结构开启补充章节
examples.negative_instruction: 不要滥用此句式；补充章节必须与主问题真实相关

examples.psychological_goal: 把跨代知识传递升华为身体记忆的意象，制造温情与敬畏
examples.expression_mechanism: It survived in A, in B that had watched other B 式身体意象白描
examples.example_text: It survived in bodies, in hands that had watched other hands and learned to move the same way
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在论证完成后用身体意象把机制写成画面，让情感接管理性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象；诗意升华必须建立在已完成的论证之上

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句克制温和的落点收束全片，把敬畏感留在日常之中
examples.expression_mechanism: And somehow + 朴素日常断言 的温和落点句
examples.example_text: And somehow most of the time the message gets through just fine.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在宏大收束之后用一句朴素、近乎家常的判断落地，避免高音收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该措辞；落点句必须与全片主题形成反差式呼应
